hooks.command: command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; sed -n 's/.*"file_path":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.vue|*.js) npx --no-install eslint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

b=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$b" = "master" ] || [ "$b" = "main" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Commit direkt auf %s. Die CLAUDE.md verlangt Worktree + eigenen Branch + PR: git worktree add -b <prefix>/<slug> ../_wt-<slug> origin/master"}}' "$b"; fi
